title: The bathroom shooting at the headquarters company
description: A drunk soldier from another company shot a man in the chest in the shower at the headquarters company latrine, right next to Larry's hooch. Larry, who did not know the victim, saw where the bullet hit and turned to help the wounded man — at which point the gunman pointed the pistol at Larry and aimed it at him. Sgt. Weaver, an E5, showed up; the shooter, eyes rolled back, passed out. Air Force police took Larry's statement. Larry heard the shooter knew the man he shot, and that he was sentenced to twenty years of hard labor, imprisoned in Okinawa. Larry's bunk mate Ron Tototz was with him during the incident. Larry dates it roughly February–March 1965 — 'been there at least 6 months.'
